note: Paraguay: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90, 60 or 30 days; Indonesia, Oman, Qatar and Vietnam take a visa on arrival for 30 days, Thailand for 15; everyone else applies (online, completed at a Paraguayan mission) for a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Paraguay
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Paraguay without a visa for the following period: 90 days All European Union member states Andorra Argentina Australia Bahamas Bolivia Brazil Canada Chile Colombia Costa Rica Ecuador El Salvador Georgia Guatemala Honduras Iceland Israel Japan Liechtenstein Mexico Monaco Mongolia New Zealand Nicaragua Norway Panama Peru Russia Saint Kitts and Nevis South Africa Switzerland Taiwan Turkey Trinidad and Tobago Ukraine United Arab Emirates United Kingdom United States United States Uruguay 60 days Dominican Republic 30 days Malaysia Philippines Singapore South Korea ... Citizens of the following countries may obtain a visa on arrival for the following period: 30 days Indonesia Oman Qatar Vietnam 15 days Thailand
